youtube.baslik: Is test room noise judged by a single decibel value? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The maximum permissible ambient noise in a test room is not given as a single number but as octave or third-octave band levels, so a single A-weighted decibel value is not enough. The microphone is placed where the patient's head will be, at ear height, with the door closed and ventilation, lights and computers running. Because noise can change during the day, repeat the measurement during the clinic's busiest hours.
